title: Population density in Utrecht
summary: Compare residents per square kilometre across Utrecht neighbourhoods using one transparent indicator.
question: Which Utrecht neighbourhoods have the highest population density?
interpretation: The map ranks population density within Utrecht. A score of 100 identifies the highest density, not a judgement of social need. Selection shows the original residents/km² value.
limitations: Neighbourhood boundaries aggregate different land uses. A neighbourhood average does not describe every street.
The project reads live CBS/PDOK data. Later source revisions can change the ranks.
